summary: Frontend-only testing of mobile UX improvements: (1) Bottom-sheet FAB search, (2) Centered Moonshot wordmark on mobile/tablet, (3) About Us scroll-fade. All 17 specified test scenarios passed on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900) viewports.

test_results.T2_mobile_4_button_grid: PASS - Explore/Portfolio/Condense/Menu all present; inline stock-search-input hidden on mobile
test_results.T3_mobile_FAB_visible: PASS - mobile-search-fab visible at bottom-right (x=314, y=708, 56x56px) on 390px viewport
test_results.T4_mobile_sheet_opens: PASS - sheet visible with drag handle, branded 'Moonshot · Stock Search' header, input, and X close
test_results.T6_mobile_search_NVDA_select: PASS - clicking mobile-search-result-NVDA closes sheet and loads NVDA stock data on main page
test_results.T8_mobile_backdrop_close: PASS - clicking outside sheet closes it
test_results.T11_about_us_scrolled: PASS - data-hidden='true', opacity=0 at scrollY=400 (>240 threshold)
test_results.T12_about_us_back_to_top: PASS - data-hidden='false', opacity=1 after scrollY returns to 0
test_results.T13_desktop_inline_search_visible: PASS - stock-search-input visible in header on desktop
test_results.T14_desktop_FAB_hidden: PASS - mobile-search-fab not visible on desktop (lg:hidden working)
test_results.T15_desktop_wordmark_hidden: PASS - app-title-mobile hidden, app-title (left logo+Moonshot) visible on desktop
test_results.T16_desktop_regression_Tesla_TSLA: PASS - typing 'Tesla' shows search-result-TSLA in dropdown; clicking loads TSLA
test_results.T17_desktop_regression_4_buttons: PASS - Explore/Portfolio/Condense/Menu all functional; Condense toggle changes label to 'Expand'; Menu opens sidebar with Watchlists/Price Alerts/Theme/Compare/Export CSV

critical_code_review_comments: MobileSearchSheet (~183 lines) — clean, focused component; correctly reuses parent's searchQuery/searchStocks/selectStock; proper Esc/body-scroll-lock/autofocus lifecycle.
AboutUs scroll listener uses rAF throttling and passive listener — good practice. Threshold (240px) matches spec.
FAB positioned at bottom-20 (80px) on mobile to avoid Emergent preview badge — confirmed correct in preview environment.
Note: App.js is ~1920+ lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into smaller modules in a future iteration (header, stock detail, sidebar, etc.). Not blocking for this task.
